corrections.text: The article quotes Alkin Tezuysal as writing that the summit's AI & Cloud block "featured four vector and AI proposals presented back-to-back by Oracle, Google, Percona, and Intel." His askdba.net post actually reads: "The first discussion block, AI & Cloud, had four vector and AI proposals back to back from Oracle, Google, Percona and Intel." The meaning is the same; the wording inside the quote marks is a paraphrase, not a verbatim quotation.

The article quotes Tezuysal as writing "Not long ago, inquiries about vector search in MySQL received polite deflection toward PostgreSQL's pgvector." His askdba.net post actually reads: "Not long ago, if you asked about vector search in MySQL, you got a polite smile and a link to pgvector." The meaning is the same; the wording inside the quote marks is a paraphrase, not a verbatim quotation.

The article describes VillageSQL's newsletter as "a second, independent account" that "corroborates the lineup" of the four summit proposals. VillageSQL's own weekly roundup entry for this item is bylined to "Alkin Tezuysal, AskDba" — it is VillageSQL's TL;DR summary of Tezuysal's askdba.net post, not a separately-gathered, independent observation of the summit.
